description: Historical lending data may contain demographic biases that disadvantage certain groups, leading to unfair loan denials.
mitigation: Regularly audit training data and model outputs for disparate impact and rebalance or reweight data when bias is detected.

description: Applicants may not understand why the model recommended approval or denial, reducing transparency and trust in the system.
mitigation: Provide clear, model-generated explanations for each recommendation using explainability techniques such as feature attribution.

description: If incorrect predictions lead to harmful outcomes, responsibility may be unclear due to lack of human oversight.
mitigation: Establish human-in-the-loop review for high-impact decisions and maintain detailed logs of model behavior and decision paths.

description: Sensitive financial and personal applicant data may be exposed or misused during model training or inference.
mitigation: Implement strict data minimization, encryption in transit and at rest, and access controls to ensure sensitive data remains protected.
